title: [M5] Canonical deterministic builds, export gates and provenance

## Problem and expected outcome

**Objective:** Publish repeatable builds from approved canonical inputs without false production labels.

**Scope:** Canonical ordering/numerics/encoders, build identity/manifest, cache, atomic publication and production/diagnostic gates.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Same source/contract/profile/composition/toolchain/output policy in two clean builds at different paths/times yields identical SPR/ACT SHA-256 hashes.
- [ ] Specify schema/action/view/frame/layer/image ordering and numeric rounding/field encodings; pin decoder/resampler/palette/color-space/encoder versions. Never reorder semantically ordered layers.
- [ ] Build identity excludes timestamps, hostname, absolute paths, random UUIDs, filesystem traversal order and native-test data; linked verification evidence remains outside deterministic artifact inputs.
- [ ] Production export rejects underspecified/missing/invalid/stale or unapproved required assignments; partial diagnostic exports are conspicuously PARTIAL_DIAGNOSTIC with scoped/full states separate.
- [ ] Manifest includes source/target/profile/policy/tool hashes, approved pre-build composition digest, output hashes and preservation/conversion policy; atomic cache/publication cannot mutate originals or publish partial production output.

## Verification

Two-clean-build hash equality, ordering/rounding regressions, interrupted publication, fail-closed export and changed-one-source affected-approval checks.

Actual commands, environment, exits, artifact hashes and NOT_RUN limits are recorded in docs/verification/rsf-25/VERIFICATION.md. No artwork approval or native run is claimed.

## Non-goals and dependencies

**Dependencies:** RSF-24 (M5-02; task ID nw62kniena0oeqe44yba8uil)

**Non-goals / gate qualifications:** Build/native evidence never creates aesthetic approval.

Original Ragnarok artwork/GRFs and private fixtures stay outside public Git/deliverables. Use synthetic redistributable fixtures for public verification. Private fixture/tool availability must be checked during execution, never assumed.
